verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p01_1: Place, entry, form, and mark, and sign indeed; raising, awakening, and wheel-rest indeed — and
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p01_2: the arrival at the stage, and the final state indeed; rest, transformation, and the return indeed — and
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p01_3: So the doctrine is thirteenfold: the supreme Śākta wisdom, pointed out in every Trika treatise by Śambhu himself.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p01_4: Five fingers below the navel, two fingers above the member — between them lies the place called the bulb, remembered as the station of the wheel.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p01_5: Hold the breath in and out, and cast the mind right there; master the currents of wind completely, and lead them until they enter the middle.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p01_6: This — they say — is entry. Now I will tell the form: a wheel like a horned pond, six-spoked, and steady beyond.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p01_7: The bulb glows like a pomegranate blossom, red by its very nature; this form is declared the third — it consists of contemplation.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p01_8: Set the mind in that middle until it stands steady there; when the wind's hold is released, point out the mark.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p01_9: In the middle of the bulb-wheel stands a digit of the unstruck sound, ringed with lines above and below, coiled like a serpent.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p01_10: Above and below abides her state — sun and moon both; truly she shines, bright as a thousand suns.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p02_11: Gaze at her, at śakti, with a light sealing of the breath; this is the sign pointed out — beyond it lies raising.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p02_12: On the practiced out-breath, utter the mantra; contemplate her awakened — the Supreme Goddess, straight as a staff.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p02_13: Come from the heart of the base, she has entered the suṣumnā road; this is raising declared — beyond it, awakening.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p02_14: Rooted in the bulb, pierce the navel, then the grandsire in the heart; in the throat the unfallen one, Rudra face to face on the palate's floor.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p02_15: At the brow's middle, Īśa; at the door of brahman, Sadāśiva; wake them and rise swiftly to the state that rests on nothing — Śiva.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p02_16: This awakening is pointed out. Then the resting in the wheels: a petal by nature, blazing, flowing, like the steady sky.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p02_17: Nectar, the crest, śakti-brahmā — and the drop-sound: so the twelvefold wheel is proclaimed, says tradition.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p02_18: Piercing in turn — śakti in wheel after wheel, at every instant — she, the Great Goddess, comes to rest: the supreme wheel-rest.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p02_19: First the heart trembles, and the palate gate; his head spins — the sign of the sight's crossing over.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p02_20: It sets each limb spinning, joint by joint; his heart churns — such is the power of true knowing.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p03_21: Whatever changes the state brews in a man — in none of them is there anything to fear; the Supreme Goddess is at play.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p03_22: Drunk on nectar, she brews change upon change — the triple-stain ferment of what was done through many births.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p03_23: She shakes the stained souls loose from the snare, risen from supreme power; this is the arrival at the stage — and the final state is told.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p03_24: When the crossing comes: hair rising, tears falling, yawning breaking, speech faltering from voices within; knots bursting, the divine shiver of touch, drops throbbing out from the navel bulb.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p03_25: That is the final state declared. And now rest is taught: when śakti wakes and pours from the navel wheel.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p03_26: Then the whole village of the senses sets and stands without; when she, the supreme power, dissolves into the supreme place.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p03_27: Then the knower finds nothing — no other thing to know; śakti rests in Śiva — this is called rest.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p03_28: Where her resting lies, let the mind go there into dissolution; then the self is known in supreme selfhood by those made firm.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p03_29: Become Śiva — the self turns Śiva; that indeed is the turning. And he rains forever the divine nectar that is the life of creatures.
verses.saktavijnana_sakt-p03_30: Hold the mind there — and the goddess enters again; then the return is proclaimed: thirteen in full.
